title: Basic worker rights
question: What basic rights do workers have in Israel?
answer: Workers in Israel generally have rights around payment, work hours, rest days, payslips, and safe working conditions. The exact rules can depend on your visa, job type, and agreement.

title: Not getting paid
question: What should I do if my employer did not pay me?
answer: Keep records of your work days, messages, contract, and payslips. Ask the employer clearly about the missing payment. If it is not solved, you may need help from a worker rights organization or legal support.
